text:
maya_k: Quick ask re: tomorrow's on-site (9am-3pm PT). Who's scribe for rounds 1-3? Also need recording consent from Candidate A — do we ask verbally before recording or send the consent link after? Also proponing a small rubric tweak: mark 'system-design clarity' explicitly (thinking +2 weight). opinions?
priya: I can take rounds 1 and 2, happy to scribe. :hand: I can also copy notes into the candidate doc afterwards. For recording, I'd prefer verbal consent in front of panel.
samir: I can cover round 3. minor flag — I have a 11:00-11:30 sync, might step out for 10–20m. happy to swap if that causes issues. :+1:
elena: Quick rubric thought — i'd avoid changing weights last minute. Instead annotate "clarity" as a required comment field so reviewers call it out, then we can discuss weight changes in retro. Also remember to collect the code repo link during the session.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: recording consent form: <https://forms.company/recording-consent>. Policy: we need explicit verbal consent before any recording starts and the candidate must be told how recording will be used.
maya_k: thanks — priya + samir confirmed. priya, can you paste a short scribe template we can reuse? i'll handle consent at start of panel.
priya: pasted below — i'll also create the doc and share link in #hiring-debriefs before 9am.
```
Scribe template:
- Candidate name:
- Role:
- Round (1/2/3):
- Panel members:
- Notes (strengths / concerns):
- Behavior / communication highlights:
- System design clarity (note):
- Code link / artifacts:
- Rubric scores: technical (1-5), design (1-5), communication (1-5)
- Follow-ups / takeaways:
```
maya_k: perfect. i'll lead consent script. small ask: can someone capture any scoring disagreements in the "Follow-ups" section so we have discrete points for debrief? :memo:
samir: will do. if i need to duck for my meeting i'll leave a short note and priya can fill gaps.
priya: noted — i'll host debrief at 3:15pm in #hiring-debriefs and paste final scribe doc there. :calendar:
